node.title: E1 open-cell typicality or folded-certificate payload
node.statement: For N' in {128,256}, provide either a uniform admissible-family typicality theorem for the explicit exceptional norm-divisor set, or named exhibit fields with complete folded kernel certificates returning no nonzero non-cyclotomic folded vector. This is reduced to the proved folded-certificate manifest soundness rule plus the remaining actual named folded-certificate manifest payload.
node.attack_surface: assembly from folded-certificate manifest soundness and the actual complete named folded-certificate transcripts for the open E1 cells
node.falsifier: missing N'=128 or N'=256 coverage, a failed folded certificate, or an admissible-field family with exceptional incidence exceeding the allowed budget
